messages.content: We're taking on 15 more staff at the Martlesham office next month, 35 people in total, and moving everyone to cloud video calls. Our broadband already struggles. What do you suggest?
I recommend upgrading to AgenticTelco Fibre 900 – that’s 900Mbps at £45 per month. Your contract ends 28 August 2027, just as it is. Would you like me to go ahead with that?
Great, I’ve got your order in with reference MVP-0518E096. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

Hi Sam, we’re currently at risk of delay for your broadband upgrade due to no 900 Mbps port being available at Martlesham Heath. The next free port will be available in two days, and the revised completion date is now 2 November 2026.
Hi Sam, great news – your AgenticTelco Fibre 900 upgrade is now live. It’s been fully completed and is active from 2 November 2026.
